title: 新学期报名、活动通知
goal: 能告诉家长新学期什么时候开始、怎么报名、有什么优惠和活动。

chunks.en: The new term starts in January.
Would you like to sign up?
chunks.note: Would you like……? 比 Do you want……? 更礼貌，对家长用这个。

chunks.en: There is a 10% discount for early sign-up.
chunks.note: 10% discount 是便宜 10%，也就是中文说的"九折"。别搞反了！

chunks.en: The last day to register is 15 December.
chunks.zh: 报名截止日期是 12 月 15 日。

chunks.en: We have a Chinese New Year event on 25 January.
chunks.zh: 我们 1 月 25 日有新年活动。

chunks.en: I'll send you the details on WhatsApp.
chunks.zh: 我会在 WhatsApp 上把详情发给您。

frames.usage: 客客气气地问对方要不要做一件事，比 Do you want to……? 更有礼貌，对家长、客人、长辈都用这个。框不变，只把那件事放进 ___。

examples.scene: 邻居 auntie 来你家门口送东西，你请她进来坐。
examples.en: Would you like to come in?

examples.scene: 周末和朋友在 hawker centre 吃饭，看到邻居 auntie 一个人坐着。
examples.en: Would you like to join us?

examples.scene: 在 MRT 上，一位老人家上了车，你站起来给他让座。
examples.en: Would you like to take a seat?
examples.note: take a seat = 坐下（不是"拿座位"）

examples.scene: 家里的电话响了，是找你老公的，可是他出去了。
examples.en: Would you like to leave a message?

examples.scene: 家长想知道新学期每个星期几上课。
examples.en: Would you like to see the timetable?

examples.scene: 家长来交新学期的学费，你问他要不要用 PayNow 付。
examples.en: Would you like to pay by PayNow?
examples.zh: 您要用 PayNow 付款吗？
examples.note: pay by PayNow = 用 PayNow 付钱

examples.scene: 新搬来的邻居还没吃过鸡饭，你带她去 hawker centre。
examples.en: Would you like to try chicken rice?
accept: Would you like to try the chicken rice?

examples.scene: 家长还在犹豫要不要给孩子报名。
examples.en: Would you like to book a trial class?
examples.zh: 您要不要先预约一节试听课？
examples.note: book = 预约；trial class = 试听课

examples.scene: 朋友来你家吃晚饭，她碗里的饭快吃完了。
examples.en: Would you like to have some more rice?
examples.note: have some more = 再吃一点（这里 have 是"吃"）

examples.scene: 新年活动快到了，你邀请来接孩子的妈妈也一起来。
examples.en: Would you like to join our New Year event?
examples.zh: 您想参加我们的新年活动吗？
accept: Would you like to join our Chinese New Year event?

daily.scene: 朋友问你星期六晚上有没有空。
daily.en: I have a party on Saturday.

daily.scene: 打电话给好朋友，请她来你家玩。
daily.en: I want to invite you to my party.

daily.scene: 家里来了客人，你切好了蛋糕。
周末带家人去动物园，在售票处问价钱。
邻居问你喜不喜欢中秋节。
过年前，邻居问你家里忙不忙。

daily.en: We celebrate Chinese New Year at home.

daily.scene: 老公问你为什么买了这么多菜。
一月一号早上，在电梯里遇到邻居。
邻居问你有没有收到楼里活动的通知。
daily.zh: 我在那个 WhatsApp 群里。
accept: I am in the WhatsApp group.

daily.scene: 去看望刚出院的朋友，你带了一束花。
中秋节晚上，和家人在公园里看灯笼。

lines.en: We have a party at home tonight.
I invite my neighbour and her family.
I send the details on WhatsApp.
lines.zh: 我在 WhatsApp 上发了详细信息。

lines.en: In the morning, I buy a cake.
lines.zh: 早上我去买了一个蛋糕。

lines.en: My husband and I cook dinner.
At 7pm, our guests come.
lines.zh: 晚上 7 点，客人们来了。

lines.en: "Hi! Would you like to come in?"
My neighbour has flowers for me.
"Happy New Year, Amy!"
We eat cake and talk.
lines.zh: 我们一边吃蛋糕一边聊天。

lines.en: We celebrate together.
It's a very happy day.

dialogue.title: 新学期报名
dialogue.setting: 十二月的一个下午，一位妈妈 Mrs Lee 来前台问新学期报名的事。

lines.speaker: Mrs Lee
lines.en: Hi, is registration open now?
lines.zh: 你好，现在可以报名了吗？

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.en: Yes, registration is open now.

lines.speaker: Mrs Lee
lines.en: When does the new term start?

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.en: The new term starts in January.

lines.speaker: Mrs Lee
lines.en: Is there a discount?

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.en: Yes. There is a 10% discount for early sign-up.

lines.speaker: Mrs Lee
lines.en: Great! Can my child sign up?
lines.zh: 太好了！我孩子可以报名吗？

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.en: Sure. Please fill in this form.

lines.speaker: Mrs Lee
lines.en: OK. Here you go.

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.en: Thank you. We have a Chinese New Year event on 25 January.
lines.zh: 谢谢。我们 1 月 25 日有一个新年活动。

lines.speaker: Mrs Lee
lines.en: Oh, nice! Can I come too?

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.en: Yes! Parents are welcome to join.

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.en: I'll send you the details on WhatsApp.
lines.zh: 我会在 WhatsApp 上把详细信息发给您。

lines.speaker: Mrs Lee
lines.en: Thank you very much!

dialogue.title: 家长来问下学期报名
dialogue.setting: 一位爸爸来前台问下个学期的报名情况。

npc.en: Hi, is registration open for next term?
npc.zh: 你好，下学期开始报名了吗？

replies.en: Yes! Would you like to sign up?

npc.en: Maybe. When does the new term start?
npc.zh: 也许吧。新学期什么时候开始？

replies.en: The new term starts in January.
There is a 10% discount for early sign-up.

npc.en: OK, I want to sign up my son.

replies.en: Great! Please fill in this form.
replies.zh: 太好了！请填写这张表格。

replies.en: Would you like to book a trial class?
replies.zh: 您要不要先预约一节试听课？

npc.en: No, it's OK. He really wants to join now.
npc.zh: 不用了。他很想现在就报名。

replies.en: Great! Please fill in this form.
replies.zh: 太好了！请填写这张表格。

npc.en: Done. Anything else I should know?
npc.zh: 填好了。还有什么我需要知道的吗？

replies.en: We have a Chinese New Year event on 25 January. Would you like to join?
replies.zh: 我们 1 月 25 日有新年活动。您想参加吗？

replies.en: I'll send you the details on WhatsApp.
replies.zh: 我会在 WhatsApp 上把详情发给您。

npc.en: Sounds fun. Can parents come too?
npc.zh: 听起来很好玩。家长也可以来吗？

replies.en: Yes! Parents are welcome to join.
replies.zh: 可以！欢迎家长一起参加。

task: 把你们中心下学期的开学时间用英语说一遍：The new term starts in ___. 然后试着告诉一位家长。
